# apple_build_beta_detail (Resource)

Manages a build's TestFlight settings. App Store Connect creates it with the build and it cannot be deleted, so creating this resource manages the existing one and destroying the resource leaves the current settings in place. Import it by build ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_build_beta_detail" "latest" {
  build_id            = data.apple_build.latest.id
  auto_notify_enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `auto_notify_enabled` (Boolean) Whether testers are notified automatically when the build becomes available to them.
- `build_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the build.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the build beta detail.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_build_beta_detail.latest
  identity = {
    build_id = "3e4f5a6b-7c8d-4e9f-a0b1-c2d3e4f5a6b7"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `build_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the build.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_build_beta_detail.latest 3e4f5a6b-7c8d-4e9f-a0b1-c2d3e4f5a6b7
```
